device.name: BLE Fitness Machine Service (FTMS)
device.notes:
FTMS is the Bluetooth SIG's standard GATT service for fitness equipment — treadmills, indoor/spin bikes, rowers, cross-trainers and steppers. It is the interoperable local-control fallback when a vendor's own profile is proprietary, and it is what apps like Zwift use to drive a trainer locally over BLE (no cloud, no account). A concrete device spec should cite this file rather than re-listing the UUIDs and opcodes.
SERVICE: 0x1826 (advertised). CHARACTERISTICS:
  0x2ACC  Fitness Machine Feature (which fields/controls the machine supports)
  0x2ACD  Treadmill Data
  0x2AD2  Indoor Bike Data
  0x2AD3  Training Status
  0x2AD9  Fitness Machine Control Point (write; take control + set targets)
  0x2ADA  Fitness Machine Status
CONTROL POINT op codes (write to 0x2AD9):
  0x00 Request Control      0x01 Reset
  0x02 Set Target Speed     0x03 Set Target Inclination
  0x04 Set Target Resistance Level   0x05 Set Target Power
  0x07 Start or Resume      0x08 Stop or Pause
HANDSHAKE: a Central must first write Request Control (0x00); the machine acknowledges via an indication on the Control Point (op code + request op code + result) before target-setting ops are honoured. DATA: the Treadmill Data / Indoor Bike Data notifications begin with a little-endian flags bitmask that says which optional fields (speed, cadence, power, heart rate, distance, calories, ...) are present; a client must parse the flags to locate each field.

openness.notes: Published SIG standard; third-party implementation is the intended use. The UUIDs and opcodes here are from the public specification. Per-field bit-by-bit layouts of Treadmill/Indoor Bike Data are in the SIG spec and should be transcribed per-field when writing a concrete device spec.

characteristics.name: Fitness Machine Feature (0x2ACC)
characteristics.notes: Bitfields declaring which data fields and target-setting controls the machine supports.

characteristics.name: Treadmill Data (0x2ACD)
characteristics.notes: Leading little-endian flags bitmask, then the present fields (speed, incline, distance, HR, ...).

characteristics.name: Indoor Bike Data (0x2AD2)
characteristics.notes: Leading flags bitmask, then the present fields (speed, cadence, power, HR, ...).

request_control.description: Take control of the machine (op 0x00). Required before any target-setting op.

set_target_power.description: Set target power (op 0x05) — s16 watts, little-endian.

power_lo.description: Low byte of target power (s16 W).

level.description: Target resistance level (units per machine, see 0x2ACC).

set_target_speed.description: Set target speed (op 0x02) — u16 in 0.01 km/h, little-endian.

speed_lo.description: Low byte of target speed (u16, 0.01 km/h).

stop_or_pause.description: Stop or pause (op 0x08). Parameter 0x01 = stop, 0x02 = pause.

characteristics.name: Fitness Machine Control Point (0x2AD9)
characteristics.notes: Take control and set targets. Write Request Control (0x00) first; the machine indicates the result before honouring target ops.

characteristics.name: Fitness Machine Status (0x2ADA)
characteristics.notes: Asynchronous status events (control taken, target changed, stopped by safety key, ...).

services.name: Fitness Machine Service (0x1826)
services.notes: The advertised FTMS service. A machine exposes a subset of the characteristics below depending on its type; read 0x2ACC (Feature) to learn which fields and controls it supports.
